representation.name: RNAcentral ViennaRNA MFE
representation.description: Retrieve an RNAcentral sequence and calculate its ViennaRNA minimum free energy structure

configfiles.retrieve_fold.py:
import json, re, subprocess, urllib.request
acc = "URS0000668495"
url = "https://rnacentral.org/api/v1/rna/" + acc
with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as response:
    record = json.load(response)
seq = record["sequence"].upper().replace("T", "U")
if not re.fullmatch(r"[ACGUN]+", seq):
    raise SystemExit("Unexpected RNAcentral sequence")
p = subprocess.run(["RNAfold", "--noPS"], input=">" + acc + "\n" + seq + "\n", text=True, capture_output=True, check=True)
lines = [x.strip() for x in p.stdout.splitlines() if x.strip()]
if len(lines) < 3:
    raise SystemExit("Unexpected RNAfold output: " + p.stdout)
m = re.fullmatch(r"([().]+)\s+\(\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\)", lines[-1])
if not m or len(m.group(1)) != len(seq):
    raise SystemExit("Could not validate RNAfold structure")
print(acc)
print(seq)
print(m.group(1))
print(f"{float(m.group(2)):.2f}")

    raise SystemExit("Unexpected RNAcentral sequence")
with open(sys.argv[2], "w") as out:
    out.write(">" + record["rnacentral_id"] + "\n" + seq + "\n")
